# Fresh Terminal

> A prompt-first terminal that routes what you type to the right model and can edit its own interface through undoable ops. This is the docs wiki: plain Markdown, dated facts, one start-here index. Updated every pass in the same commit as the work. Last updated 2026-09-29 (domain, sign-in and D1 pass).

Base URLs: GitHub https://github.com/imagine-os/fresh-terminal/blob/main/terminal/docs/ · raw https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imagine-os/fresh-terminal/main/terminal/docs/ · rendered https://imagine-os.github.io/fresh-terminal/wiki/ (each page also at /wiki/<path>.md as plain Markdown). Links below are relative to terminal/docs/.

Rules for readers: the Canon is the current truth; when two lines disagree, the newer dated one wins and the older is marked superseded. Numbered files are append-only history. Proposals are labelled "proposed" until Justin decides. No secret values appear anywhere; secrets are named only.

## Reference

- [reference/surfaces.md](reference/surfaces.md): router API (/route SSE, /tag, /me, /sync/boxes, /sync/ledger), ops as tools, action runner, window.pond, D1, SpacetimeDB, CLI, MCP, deploy workflows
- [decisions/0021-free-credits.md](decisions/0021-free-credits.md): free credits enforced by the router (25¢ per browser, 2 soft prompts, $1 per account, $2/day cap), abuse limits, GET /credits, cost estimates
- [decisions/0020-domain-clerk-d1.md](decisions/0020-domain-clerk-d1.md): freshterminal.ai on a Worker, api.freshterminal.ai, Clerk anonymous-first, D1 schema and sync rules, limits
- [decisions/0016-self-editing.md](decisions/0016-self-editing.md): how the interface edits itself (ops, undo, tool calling, escalation)
- [decisions/0017-chips-and-structured-replies.md](decisions/0017-chips-and-structured-replies.md): chip kinds, glossary, reply blocks
- [decisions/0018-skins-and-refine.md](decisions/0018-skins-and-refine.md): skins as records, the refine() best-of-3 loop, stop rules, /skin endpoints
- [brand/registry.md](brand/registry.md): brand marks registry (source, terms, date per file)
- [decisions/0019-playback.md](decisions/0019-playback.md): replay, steps with parent ids, state rebuilt at any step, branches later
